purpose: Harden repository private-key scanning so approved regression fixtures do not block server signing smoke while real secrets still block.
securityInvariants: Production must not sign with dev-local material.
Repo-resident private key PEM blocks are blocked unless the file is an approved regression fixture.
Approved fixture PEMs are counted separately and surfaced in reports.
Payload, signature, and keyId tampering must be rejected.
No private key PEM is generated in local-runtime dev signing material.
